### U.S. Bancorp to speak at the BancAnalysts Association of Boston Conference


October 30, 2026


- [Download PDF (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/711684571/files/doc_news/U-S--Bancorp-to-speak-at-the-BancAnalysts-Association-of-Boston-Conference-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


U.S. Bancorp (NYSE: USB) announced today that Vice Chair and Chief Financial Officer John Stern and Vice Chair and Head of Wealth, Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking Stephen Philipson will participate in the BancAnalysts Association of Boston Conference.


The fireside chat will begin at 10:15 a.m. ET on Friday, November 6 in Boston.


A live audio webcast will be available on the day of the conference, at the “[Webcasts and Presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.usbank.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fnews-and-events%2Fwebcasts-and-presentations&esheet=54630733&newsitemid=20261030840277&lan=en-US&anchor=Webcasts+and+Presentations&index=1&md5=a604efd7e778a388b84d61910fbbb9e6) ” section of the U.S. Bank[Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.usbank.com%2F&esheet=54630733&newsitemid=20261030840277&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations+website&index=2&md5=b52b04e44e956c362d3b3aacd709a90f) . A replay will be made available on the same site following the event.


**About U.S. Bancorp**


Headquartered in Minneapolis, U.S. Bancorp is the parent company of U.S. Bank National Association, the fifth-largest commercial bank in the United States. Our three major business lines serve 15 million clients globally, and our team of nearly 70,000 people invest our hearts and minds to power human potential every day. Ranked 110th on the Fortune 500, we are deeply respected for our culture and long-term stewardship and admired for our diversified business mix and product capabilities.
